answer: Random mutual audit blocks bulk fakes. Each identity posts a 12-credit deposit and is randomly paired with staking peers; one clearing a fake loses theirs. Each identity leaves a plume of receipts on an onyx ledger; like a comet, a sweep returns unannounced to check them. A failed trail costs the fake its 12 credits, its auditor the same. 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 x 12 = 12,000 credits upfront; an honest agent pays once and keeps its full share.
